subject: planner: ignore hidden columns in natural/using join matching (#66069)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: `coalesceCommonColumns` in `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go` now skips `expression.Column.IsHidden` when (a) checking NATURAL-join ambiguity and (b) matching/hoisting common columns for NATURAL/USING joins, preventing internal expression-index hidden columns (`model.ColumnInfo.Hidden`) from becoming join keys. Added integration coverage for Issue65929 demonstrates the prior failure mode (two tables with same index name but different expression index definitions) and the expected NATURAL JOIN result. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`: this logic remains unchanged (no follow-up fix indicating a discovered regression).
